title: SYNTHETIC TEST CASE: Global Excellence Grant 2026
description: Congratulations! You have been pre-selected for our fully-funded Global Excellence Grant. Act now — only 3 slots remaining! To secure your spot, send a refundable processing fee of $150 via Western Union within 24 hours.
eligibility: Open to everyone, no requirements needed.
note: Combines all three text-pattern red flags deliberately: upfront payment via a hard-to-trace method, artificial urgency, and no real eligibility criteria. This is the clearest, most textbook scam pattern - should score High Risk with all three signals present in trustEvidence.

title: SYNTHETIC TEST CASE: Quiet Achievers Bursary
description: A small, real-sounding bursary for undergraduate students. No red-flag language of any kind - just a description of what the bursary supports.
eligibility: Applicants must be enrolled full-time in an undergraduate programme and submit a 500-word personal statement.
note: A synthetic case designed to look completely legitimate - no upfront payment, no urgency, specific and reasonable eligibility criteria. This tests that the trust layer doesn't produce false positives on a clean, boring, realistic listing. If this scores anything above Low Risk, that's a bug worth investigating.

title: SYNTHETIC TEST CASE: Limited-Time Scholar Award
description: Apply immediately or lose this opportunity forever! Limited spots available this week only.
eligibility: Nationality: Any. Field of study: Any. GPA: minimum 3.0.
note: Isolates the urgency signal alone, with otherwise reasonable, specific eligibility criteria and no payment request. Tests that a single weak signal (weight 1) correctly stays below the Some Concerns threshold (2) rather than over-triggering on one red flag alone - matches the calibration decision documented in trust.js.

title: SYNTHETIC TEST CASE: Phantom Foundation Award
description: An award from an organization with no verifiable presence anywhere online, no website, no social media, no news coverage. This test case checks the search-evidence-dependent signals specifically.
eligibility: Open to everyone, no experience necessary.
note: This one specifically exercises the search-evidence path (src/search.js) rather than only the text-pattern checks - since 'Phantom Foundation Award' should genuinely return no relevant results from DuckDuckGo (it doesn't exist), this is a real test of whether independentResultsFound/secondarySourceFound correctly come back false rather than accidentally keyword-matching unrelated pages.
